description: The review responder's configuration for an own iOS app: whether it is switched on, manual vs auto mode (auto posts AI replies after a delay, only for reviews written after auto was enabled and within the star range), the reply instructions, sign-off, reply language, last sync, plus whether App Store Connect is connected and this month's AI-draft usage (included allowance, then 1 credit per extra draft). settings is null until the responder is switched on. Requires an Indie plan (trial counts), App Store Connect connected in Sonar, and the app to be one of your own iOS apps.

app_id.description: Sonar app UUID of one of your own iOS apps (an `id` from sonar_list_apps). NOT a store id.

name: sonar_review_responder
title: Review Responder Settings
